title: FARO: Function-Space Adaptive Return-to-Risk Optimization via Cross-Block Equal-Risk-Contribution Budget Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.40858v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training a large language model is compute-bound, and current recipes divide the work between optimizers by hand: orthogonalized momentum for attention and MLP matrices, Adam-style updates for the rest. This division rests on human priors about which layer type deserves which geometry, and it fixes a single global update budget that every parameter block shares. We introduce FARO, a function-space adaptive optimizer that makes the partition of parameters into blocks the unit of decision. FARO gives each block a geometry by its realized counterfactual return, then freezes the routes and reallocates the frozen per-block budget by cross-block equal risk contribution (ERC), the risk-parity principle from portfolio theory. On a GPT-style model trained on FineWeb, the framework gives two results. First, its FARO-Adaptive arm reaches 3.2780 nats at the full schedule, matching NorMuonAndAdam (3.2794), the best hand-designed recipe: it recovers

translated_title: FARO：通过跨块等风险贡献预算分配实现的函数空间自适应收益-风险优化
translated_abstract: 训练大语言模型受计算资源限制，而当前的训练方案通过手工方式在优化器之间分配工作：对注意力机制和MLP矩阵使用正交化动量，对其余部分使用Adam风格的更新。这种划分依赖于人类关于哪类层值得哪种更新几何的先验知识，并且固定了一个由所有参数块共享的单一全局更新预算。我们提出FARO，一种函数空间自适应优化器，它将参数划分为块作为决策的基本单元。FARO根据每个块实现的反事实收益为其分配几何结构，然后冻结这些路径，并通过跨块等风险贡献（ERC，源自投资组合理论的风险平价原则）来重新分配冻结的每块预算。在FineWeb数据集上训练的GPT风格模型上，该框架给出了两个结果。首先，其FARO-Adaptive分支在完整训练计划下达到3.2780 nats，与最佳手工设计配方NorMuonAndAdam（3.2794）相当：它恢复了……
tldr: FARO提出了一种以参数块为决策单元的函数空间自适应优化器，根据各块的反事实收益自动分配更新几何，并借助投资组合理论中的等风险贡献原则跨块重新分配更新预算，在GPT模型训练上达到与最佳手工设计优化器配方相当的性能。
en_tdlr: FARO is a function-space adaptive optimizer that treats parameter blocks as the decision unit, assigns update geometries based on realized counterfactual returns, and reallocates frozen per-block budgets via cross-block equal-risk-contribution from portfolio theory, matching the best hand-designed optimizer recipe on GPT-style model training.
